subject.title: feat(ui): add reactive OpenClaw health nudges

question: Should the Control UI adopt proactive, once-per-visit health nudges as a supported custodian-page behavior after the gateway-scope isolation repair?
rationale: The patch adds a new operator-facing intervention policy rather than repairing an established UI contract, and the `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling of that product direction.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded nudge policy
options.body: Keep the restrained health-nudge behavior, require the gateway-scope reset fix, and review the qualifying-event policy as the intended product contract.

options.title: Narrow to passive health visibility
options.body: Retain existing health and chat surfaces without proactive prompting if maintainers do not want event-driven custodian interventions.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded nudge policy
recommendation.body: Keep the restrained health-nudge behavior, require the gateway-scope reset fix, and review the qualifying-event policy as the intended product contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned to the PR and authored the current implementation and its focused behavior tests.
